note: Track steps-to-leaps (voice-intervals), step 5: Do Re Mi Re Do over a drone and a metronome, one note per beat, on one staff. Rewritten from the plan exercise (ChoiceSplit3): the Stage selector that set the tempo is a move now (60 to 92), with any key beside it, so the text names the tempo as a param, says what stays the same in another key and mentions no selector. It says to start from the low Do, since the staff shows more notes than the drill uses.

exercise.title: Do Re Mi on the beat
exercise.why: The metronome marks where each note starts, so with one note per beat you can hear whether your voice is on Re and Mi in time or still sliding up to them.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone, the metronome and the mic start together, with the metronome at {{=bpm}}. Sing {{1}} {{2}} {{3}} {{2}} {{1}} from the low {{1}}, one note per beat. Sing it on the note names.
Stay with it until every note starts on its beat. If the notes come late, sing it on "oo" for a while.
In another key Do is a new note, and Re and Mi are still the next two steps up.
